contexts.og_config: public page-level hcti: metadata for OG Image Configs

parameters.name: html
parameters.description: HTML to render.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The fully qualified URL of a public page to capture.

parameters.name: css
parameters.description: CSS used to style the rendered image or modify a captured page.

parameters.name: content_version
parameters.description: Change an OG image's content identity when content at the same path changes.

parameters.name: metadata
parameters.description: Custom metadata stored with an image.

parameters.name: max_render_once
parameters.description: Ensure an image is rendered and saved only once.

parameters.name: additional_header_origins
parameters.description: Allow custom `headers` on requests to specific additional HTTP or HTTPS origins.

parameters.name: block_consent_banners
parameters.description: When set to `true`, automatically blocks cookie consent banners and popups on websites. Most useful for URL screenshots.

parameters.name: color_scheme
parameters.description: Set Chrome to render in `light` or `dark` mode. Affects websites using `prefers-color-scheme`.

parameters.name: dedupe_duration_s
parameters.description: Reuse an identical recent image without consuming image credits. Sets the lookback window in seconds; defaults and allowed values vary by image type and plan.

parameters.name: device_scale
parameters.description: Control resolution by adjusting the pixel ratio from `0.1` to `3`. Higher values increase image quality and file size.

parameters.name: disable_twemoji
parameters.description: Set to `true` to use native emoji fonts instead of Twemoji.

parameters.name: full_screen
parameters.description: Generate an image of the entire height of a URL page.

parameters.name: google_fonts
parameters.description: Load one or more Google fonts, such as `Roboto|Open Sans`.

parameters.name: headers
parameters.description: Add custom HTTP headers when screenshotting a URL. Headers are restricted to the requested URL's origin and any `additional_header_origins`.

parameters.name: identify_as_hcti
parameters.description: Add `X-HCTI-SCREENSHOT: 1` to the top-level request when screenshotting a URL.

parameters.name: include_headers_on_subrequests
parameters.description: Also add custom `headers` to same-origin subrequests and subrequests matching `additional_header_origins`.

parameters.name: jumbo_max_height
parameters.description: Maximum output height in jumbo mode, up to `80,000` pixels. Must be set with `jumbo_max_width` and consumes additional image credits.

parameters.name: jumbo_max_width
parameters.description: Maximum output width in jumbo mode, up to `80,000` pixels. Must be set with `jumbo_max_height` and consumes additional image credits.

parameters.name: max_wait_ms
parameters.description: Set a maximum time limit from `500` to `10000` milliseconds for waiting before taking the screenshot.

parameters.name: media_type
parameters.description: Set Chrome to render using `screen` or `print` CSS media styles.

parameters.name: ms_delay
parameters.description: Delay before generating the image. Useful when waiting for JavaScript; start with `500` milliseconds.

parameters.name: pdf_options
parameters.description: Customize PDF output with page size, margins, scale, and background printing.

parameters.name: proxy_id
parameters.description: Route outbound traffic through one of your organization's configured HTTP proxies. Available on the 10,000 images/month plan or higher.

parameters.name: render_when_ready
parameters.description: Wait to generate the image until JavaScript calls `ScreenshotReady()`.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Crop the image to an element matching this CSS selector, such as `section#complete-toolkit.container-lg`.

parameters.name: storage_destination_id
parameters.description: Save rendered files to one of your organization's configured storage destinations. Available on the 10,000 images/month plan or higher.

parameters.name: timezone
parameters.description: Set Chrome's timezone with an IANA identifier such as `America/New_York`.

parameters.name: transparent_background
parameters.description: Set to `true` to render with a transparent background.

parameters.name: viewport_height
parameters.description: Set the height of Chrome's viewport. Both dimensions must be set when using either.

parameters.name: viewport_landscape
parameters.description: Set Chrome's viewport to landscape mode.

parameters.name: viewport_mobile
parameters.description: Set Chrome's viewport to emulate a mobile device.

parameters.name: viewport_touch
parameters.description: Set Chrome's viewport to support touch events.

parameters.name: viewport_width
parameters.description: Set the width of Chrome's viewport. Both dimensions must be set when using either.
